optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Capacity Planning Analyst, Enterprise Knowledge Base
professionalSummary: Experienced in forecasting per-customer search and sync load using user counts and document growth, with monthly recalibration against platform metrics.
Translates forecasts into index‑shard and storage plans presented to platform leadership.
Demonstrated impact by reducing capacity‑related incidents from 7 to 2 within a year.
Manages capacity change approvals across platform and customer teams.
Maintains detailed assumptions notes for each planning cycle.
experienceHighlights: Kept the per‑customer load model that predicts search queries and sync volume from user counts and document growth; every month I recalibrated it against the platform metrics warehouse.
Turned each quarter's forecast into an index‑shard and storage plan that the platform team and I took to the quarterly planning meeting.

Capacity‑related incidents fell from 7 in the first half of the year to 2 in the second half after the shard rebalancing plan was applied, as counted in the platform incident register against its published baseline of 7 incidents per half‑year.

Took capacity changes through the quarterly planning meeting with the platform and customer teams; the platform lead approved shard changes and the customer teams handled communication with their accounts.
Kept an assumptions note per cycle covering the model inputs, the fact that bulk document imports sat outside the forecast, and what the next cycle inherited.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Work sample: a year of the incident register filtered to capacity‑related incidents (with the baseline and the rebalancing plan marked) and one cycle's assumptions note; export identifiers are included for tracing.
optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume and work sample establish the candidate’s experience with forecasting, planning, incident reduction, approval processes, and documentation, but do not provide independent verification of metrics or external stakeholder confirmation.
